scientific_integrity: The model, its mixing/eigenvalue properties, the broad empirical-process limit framework, standard Gaussian comparison inequality, and killed heat kernel are credited as prior foundations. All derived claims have analytic proofs and finite reproducibility checks; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Known uniform margins and known copula parameters. The formula is an asymptotic null law, not a finite-sample or fitted-parameter calibration. The complete historical priority of the result is provisional; a related 2025 handbook chapter could not be inspected in full.
title: Exact Kolmogorov–Smirnov calibration for a two-level copula Markov chain
